name: Close Support
description:
Fight war with war, and death with death.
<Originium Pollution> Continuously deals True damage to units on it and greatly reduces their SP recovery.
<Active Originium Storm> Deals True Damage to units in its area every second and greatly reduces their SP recovery.
Environmental Conditions: 
Enemy HP increased, and some enemies will differ.

tokens.name: Withered Altar
tokens.description: Enemy-side altar. Destroy it to release a Beacon at this location. Does not block the route or occupy an operator slot. Cannot be retreated.

abilities.text: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and causes Originium pollution.
Increases the strength of an Active Originium Storm when consumed by it.
Attacks deal Arts damage when inside Originium pollution.
Attacks deal Physical damage to all surrounding units.
When inside Originium pollution or an Active Originium Storm, attacks deal Physical damage to all surrounding allied units and all your units inside Originium pollution or Active Originium Storms.

waveSchedule.scope: No-deployment route/wave sweep with raised life only, using the compiled stage time limit; not a playable clear or fidelity approval

browserStartup.scope: Mobile landscape browser startup and canvas runtime; not a fidelity approval
